title: With active and inactive matches, the active part's number is named
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have at the test location an active part, part A, and an inactive part, part B, on two different Part Library entries, whose part numbers differ only in hyphens or periods (such a pair comes from data saved before this release, or from the parts import, which can add one when the number matches a Part Library entry stocked only at another location).
  • Use a number to type, number 1: part A's number in lower case with spaces in place of its hyphens, so it matches both parts.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a description in the Description field.
  3. Type number 1 in the Part Number field.
  4. Pick any category in the Category field.
  5. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads number 1.

Step 4:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The part is not saved.
  • The red message names the active part: part A's part number followed by "already exists at this location.", with "Please try to resolve this." under it.
  • It is not the inactive-part message, and it does not name part B.

Step 7:

  • The window closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-N5a: “If the location stocks both an active and an inactive part with that number, the save is refused with the message of S7-N3. The message names the active part's number.”
  • S7-N3: “If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is active, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location."”
  • S7-N5: “For S7-N3 and S7-N4, "the same number" ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods, spaces and other blank characters. The message names the number of the part already there.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “New part's number already stocked here, active | "{part number} already exists at this location." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • Story 7, context note: “Context note (S7-N7): in one rare case the import can still add a second part whose number differs from a stocked part only by punctuation, when the Part Library entry it matches is not the one stocked here. The duplicate merge tool cleans these up; the import does not refuse them.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.5 The same number again, in lower case". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-05-p1-5-duplicate-refused.png

The design's own words:

  • “Typing f40010212 at a location that already stocks F40010212 is refused with "F40010212 already exists at this location." (S7-N3). Upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored, and the message names the number of the part already there (S7-N5). The second line, "Please try to resolve this.", is the caption every error toast in the app carries.”
